card.title: One More Favor
card.instruction: Treat every small request as part of a long-running balance sheet of favors, inconveniences, and repayments.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll watch your dog tonight. That settles your fixing my sink.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He just sleeps. Your sink took three hours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave him tomorrow too, then. Two nights for the awkward pipe.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave dinner for you. There's lasagne in the fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't feed me. I'm trying to get even. If you cook as well, I'll have to take him on holiday.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offsets dog-sitting against sink repair; A3 recalculates repayment after B2; A5 treats B4's dinner as another debt. The balance sheet governs even generosity.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's three-hour repair makes A3 offer a second night; B4's lasagne makes A5 anticipate owing a holiday's dog care.

relationship.evidence: B2 disputes the value of repayment, while B4 offers considerate hospitality. A3 and A5 respond to both sides of this reciprocal friendship.

heightening.evidence: A3 increases repayment to two nights; B4's additional kindness drives A5 toward holiday care. The escalation is clear, though still a proposed obligation.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes tonight's dog care and an earlier sink repair immediately; B2's three hours and B4's fridge lasagne give actors concrete circumstances.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'Don't feed me. I'm trying to get even' earns its reversal from B4's hospitality, although the following holiday explanation slightly extends the beat.

evidence.b2CausesA3: B2 says the sleeping dog requires less effort than the three-hour repair; A3 increases the repayment to two nights.
evidence.b4CausesA5: B4 adds dinner to the exchange; A5 resists accepting it because further kindness would increase A's debt.
evidence.cardContribution: A1, A3 and A5 consistently price care against previous favors, including A's sincere wish to repay B.
evidence.sameGameHeightened: The accounting expands from one night's dog care in A1 to two nights in A3 and prospective holiday care in A5 without settling the actual scene.

records.reservation: A5's holiday escalation is verbal and hypothetical, but it remains playable and causally earned. No rewrite needed.

card.title: Must Be Nice
card.instruction: Treat another person’s ease with ordinary life as both inspiring and unfair. Copy their shortcuts while dismissing the advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You remembered every birthday. Must be nice having that sort of time.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I use phone reminders. Here, I'll send you the calendar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll import it. Some of us remember people because we care.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's also a reminder to buy the cards a week ahead.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Turn that on too. Mum calls you thoughtful for obeying your phone. Don't tell her you've sent me this.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 imports B2's calendar while claiming greater care; A5 adopts B4's advance reminder while dismissing B's thoughtfulness as obeying a phone. Inspiration appears through copying rather than expressed admiration.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 offers a shared calendar, which A3 imports. B4 reveals the card-buying reminder, which A5 activates before asking B to conceal the assistance from Mum.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 consistently offer practical help; A5 reveals sibling competition over Mum's praise. B has a coherent helpful role, though little independent stake is expressed.

heightening.evidence: B4's extra reminder leads A5 to copy more of the system and recruit B into hiding the dependence from Mum, raising the personal stakes beyond A3's initial insult.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes remembered birthdays; B2 supplies an immediately usable phone calendar; B4 specifies buying cards a week ahead, and A5 identifies the family audience.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'I'll import it' directly undercuts the claim to remember through care. A5's secrecy request earns another turn of hypocrisy, although its three sentences carry several beats.

evidence.b2CausesA3: B2 supplies the calendar shortcut; A3 explicitly adopts it through importing while asserting moral superiority.
evidence.b4CausesA5: B4 identifies the advance purchase reminder; A5 requests that exact feature and then seeks to preserve the appearance of unaided thoughtfulness.
evidence.cardContribution: A1 resents B's apparent spare time; A3 and A5 copy the conveniences while dismissing the merit of using them.
evidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 extends A3's private contradiction into concealment from Mum, making B both the source of the shortcut and keeper of A's secret.

records.reservation: The inspiring aspect is conveyed indirectly through eager adoption. B mostly supplies useful features, but the family stakes and concealment request provide sufficient interaction. No rewrite needed.

card.title: I Packed for You
card.instruction: Take care of practical needs before anyone asks, then resist choices that make your preparation unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed lunches for your first week at college.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My room doesn't have a fridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll drop one off every morning. I've labelled the days.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Lunch is included in my fees. I'm meeting my flatmates there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How many flatmates? I'll pack theirs too. You can all meet me outside.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 has already packed a week's lunches; A3 preserves the preparation despite B2's missing fridge; A5 redirects B4's social lunch plan so the packed food remains necessary.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's lack of refrigeration prompts A3's daily delivery. B4's included lunch and flatmates prompt A5 to offer food for those flatmates and relocate their meeting outside.

relationship.evidence: B2 raises a practical constraint and B4 asserts a social plan. A3 and A5 show sincere care becoming intrusive, although the precise family relationship remains implicit.

heightening.evidence: A3 commits to daily deliveries; B4's flatmates make A5 expand the preparation to a group and attempt to absorb B's independent social arrangement.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes the first college week; B2's room lacks a fridge; A3's labeled lunches and B4's meal fees make the situation immediately playable.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'How many flatmates?' efficiently turns B4's reason to decline into a larger packing assignment. 'Meet me outside' completes the same controlling-care logic.

evidence.b2CausesA3: B2 cannot store the lunches in a fridge; A3 changes from supplying a week's food at once to daily delivery.
evidence.b4CausesA5: B4 explains that lunch already provides food and a meeting with flatmates; A5 tries to replace both functions by feeding the group outside.
evidence.cardContribution: A1's unsolicited preparation remains the priority through A3's extra work and A5's resistance to an arrangement that renders it redundant.
evidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 expands care from B alone to B's flatmates, preserving the prepared-lunch project at greater effort and social intrusion. B remains free to respond.

records.reservation: A5 answers the social reason for attending lunch more directly than the already-paid cost. That selective response fits A's insistence, but gives B a substantial unresolved objection. No rewrite needed.
